title: Regularized Subjective-Surface Flow with Monotone Reaction: Global Classical Well-Posedness and Stability
summary:
Touching and dividing cell nuclei may appear as connected structures in microscopy images, making it difficult to distinguish neighboring nuclei during segmentation. We introduce and analyze a regularized subjective-surface model designed for this setting.
